item.title: US and Gulf states turn to Ukraine to counter Iranian drone attacks
item.summary: The supply of weaponry and drone interceptors could shape the future of the war with Iran, as the US and Gulf nations are trying to find cheaper ways to intercept Iranian drones, before they hit their targets. And it's actually Ukraine actually may have role to play here.
